response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  1-888-510-9613 is the bill-pay help line for NIPSCO: call for NIPSCO account number, with the account number ready and the receipt kept.  Ask 1-888-510-9613 about NIPSCO account number; a bank source carries no fee, and the confirmation number is read back at the end. Run NIPSCO login with 1-888-510-9613 when the site balks; a card adds a small fee, a bank source does not. To handle NIPSCO sign in, use nipsco.com or call 1-888-510-9613; either way the receipt is the proof worth keeping. Keep every confirmation 1-888-510-9613 gives until a later statement shows the payment posted.
response.title: Sorting Out NIPSCO Account Number
